reason: The node says the purification channel 'produces a state indistinguishable from n copies of a random purification' without acknowledging that this is only approximate: the channel can only be implemented to delta error in diamond distance (main.tex line 95, line 216). The paper explicitly splits the error budget, allocating delta/2 to the purification channel approximation and delta/2 to the pure state tomography step (line 213-217). This approximation error should be mentioned since it affects the overall failure probability analysis.
